Acquired data center cooling provider Stellar Energy for ~$553M. Raised FY2026 revenue growth guidance to ~9.5%, adj EPS $14.75-14.95.

JCI.title: Johnson Controls Q2 FY2026: Orders +30%; Record Backlog $20B; Adj EPS +45% to $1.19; Raises FY2026 Guidance
JCI.content: JCI Q2 FY2026: sales +8% to $6.1B (organic +6%), adj EPS $1.19 (+45% YoY); orders +30% with record $20B backlog driven by data center and technology demand. Raised FY2026 guidance to ~6% organic sales growth and adj EPS ~$4.85.

JCI.title: Johnson Controls AI Factory Reference Design Guide 2.0: Air-Cooled Chillers for 1GW Hyperscale Data Centers
JCI.content: Johnson Controls released its second AI Factory Reference Design Guide covering air-cooled chiller architectures for data centers up to 1GW — targeting hyperscaler AI factories. Guide specifies 220MW cluster designs: 50MW returned to AI factory (energy recovery), 32% annual energy reduction, zero-water operation (saving 12M+ gallons/day), 30% COP improvement with 27% fewer chillers. JCI Q2 FY2026 orders +30%, backlog record $20B.

NRG.title: NRG Energy Q1 2026: Revenue $10.26B Post-LS Power Acquisition; EPS $1.49 Misses $2.78 Estimate on Texas Weather Costs
NRG.content: NRG Q1 2026: revenue $10.26B (from $8.59B) following January close of ~$13B LS Power acquisition (13GW gas generation). EPS $1.49 missed $2.78 consensus due to mild Texas weather and Winter Storm Fern supply costs. Reaffirmed 2026 guidance; announced $1B share buyback.

NRG.title: NRG Energy Signs Long-Term 295MW Power Deal for Two Texas AI Data Centers on Company-Owned Sites
NRG.content: NRG signed a long-term 295MW power supply agreement serving two data centers on company-owned Texas sites, part of its strategy to monetize the expanded post-LS Power generation fleet for AI data center demand growth.

KMI.title: Kinder Morgan Q1 2026: EPS +41% to $0.48; Acquires Monument Pipeline for $505M; Moody's Upgrades to Baa1
KMI.content: KMI Q1 2026: adj EPS +41% YoY to $0.48, revenue +13.8% to $4.83B. Announced and closed $505M acquisition of Monument Pipeline (225-mile Houston-area system) on May 1. Moody's upgraded to Baa1. Long take-or-pay contracts expand Texas intrastate gas network supporting data center generation.

KMI.title: Kinder Morgan Greenlights $7B in New Natural Gas Pipeline Projects for Data Center Power and LNG Export Demand
KMI.content: Kinder Morgan approved $7B in new pipeline projects: MSX (Mississippi Crossing), SSE4 (South System Expansion 4), and Trident Intrastate Pipeline ($1.8B, 219 miles, 2 Bcf/d from Katy to Port Arthur, TX). Projects add ~3.4+ Bcf/d capacity targeting data center power generation growth and LNG export terminals. Total project backlog $9.3B; dividend raised to $1.19/share (9th consecutive annual increase).

WMB.title: Williams Companies Q1 2026: Record Adj EBITDA $2.25B (+13% YoY); Raises Growth CapEx to $7.3B; Dividend +5%
WMB.content: Williams Q1 2026: record adj EBITDA $2.25B (+13% YoY), adj EPS $0.73 beat $0.65 consensus. Deepwater Gulf EBITDA +60%+, Natural Gas Storage +35%. Raised growth CapEx midpoint to $7.3B; increased annualized dividend 5% to $2.10/share. Reaffirmed 2026 EBITDA guidance $8.05-8.35B.

ASE.title: ASE Technology Q1 2026: Revenue +17.2% YoY to NT$173.7B (~$5.44B); ATM Segment +29.7%; Net Income Nearly Doubles
ASE.content: ASE Technology Q1 2026: net revenues +17.2% YoY to NT$173.7B (~$5.44B USD). ATM (assembly, testing, materials) +29.7% YoY; net income nearly doubled to NT$14.1B. Gross margin +3.3 pp YoY to 20.1%. Advanced packaging (CoWoS/SoIC) demand driving growth. ADR shares rose ~3.4% premarket.

ASE.title: ASE Technology Advanced Packaging Sales to Double to $3.2B in 2026; Leading CoWoP Development for NVIDIA Next-Gen Architecture
ASE.content: ASE Technology projects advanced packaging sales to double to $3.2B in 2026 as TSMC outsources CoWoS capacity overflow amid AI chip demand. ASE CoWoS wafer capacity projected at 20,000-25,000/month by year-end (3x current). ASE/SPIL leading development of CoWoP (Chip-on-Wafer-on-PCB) — NVIDIA's next packaging architecture that eliminates the substrate — in coordination with leading PCB manufacturers.

AMKR.title: Amkor Technology Q1 2026: Record Revenue $1.685B (+27% YoY); EPS $0.33 Beats by 50%; Q2 Guided $1.75-1.85B
AMKR.content: Amkor Q1 2026: record net sales $1.685B (+27% YoY), EPS $0.33 beat $0.22 consensus by 50% on broad-based demand and advanced packaging (2.5D/3D) strength. Q2 guided $1.75-1.85B with EPS $0.42-0.52. Full-year capex $2.5-3.0B for capacity expansion. Stock fell ~9% AH despite the beat.

AMKR.title: Amkor and TSMC Expand Arizona Advanced Packaging Partnership; Amkor to Build Largest U.S. Packaging Facility ($7B Investment)
AMKR.content: Amkor Technology and TSMC expanded their partnership to collaborate on advanced packaging in Arizona, directly supporting TSMC's Arizona semiconductor fabs. Amkor is investing $7B to build the largest advanced packaging facility in the United States — producing 2.5D and 3D package configurations for AI chips including NVIDIA Blackwell and next-generation architectures. Facility expected to begin production in 2027.

AMKR.title: Amkor Prices $1.0B in 0% Convertible Notes Due 2031; Stock Jumps 6% on Capital Market Confidence
